summary: PER-CHILD BOOKING DEDUPE — END-TO-END PASS. BACKEND: 5/5 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_per_child_dedupe.py all pass (pytest_per_child_dedupe.xml). Confirmed: (a) POST /api/bookings with a pending same-child re-post RESUMES the pending row (same booking_id, no duplicate), (b) after marking the same-child booking paid (via /api/payments/checkout use_class_pass=true) a 2nd POST returns HTTP 409 with detail 'TEST_Alice is already booked into this class.', (c) POST with a DIFFERENT child_id returns 200 with a distinct booking, (d) both children appear as separate rows in /api/admin/bookings for the same class_id with distinct child_id / child_name / child_age, (e) backend still blocks under-min-age (400 'ages 8'). FRONTEND: verified end-to-end on the live Expo web preview at mobile viewport 390x844. Logged in as info@maxenergy.com.au, seeded 2 children (TEST_UIAlice/10, TEST_UIBob/12) via /api/me/children, opened /class/cls_a38f3d888984 (Kids Muay Thai min 8/max 16). Tap 1: BOOK & PAY → 'Who's attending?' picker opened showing BOTH children selectable; picked Alice → credit modal showed 'Use a class pass — book free (27 left)' → tapped it → POST /api/bookings body captured on the wire = {class_id, cal_reminder_minutes:60, child_age:10, child_name:'TEST_UIAlice', child_id:'kid_1725502673eb'} → booking bk_aeb18732aff4 created, then /api/payments/checkout use_class_pass=true marked it paid. Tap 2: navigated back to same class → BOOK & PAY → picker RE-OPENED (bug that blocked this in earlier iterations is gone) → Alice row rendered at 50% opacity with green checkmark and label '10 years · already booked in this class' (see screenshot picker_second_open.png), Bob row remained tappable with chevron → picked Bob → paid-with-pass → POST /api/bookings body = {class_id, cal_reminder_minutes:60, child_age:12, child_name:'TEST_UIBob', child_id:'kid_3ed2d8f014e5'} → booking bk_0b9f422a7017 created & paid. Cross-check via /api/admin/bookings: BOTH rows visible, distinct child_ids, distinct child_names, both status=paid, both paid_with_pass=true. Regressions: under-min-age still blocked (pytest), child_name+child_age still persist on booking + surface on receipt + admin chip (visible in booking rows).
action_items: [Pre-existing, NOT part of this feature] /api/admin/bookings/{id}/cancel does NOT auto-refund a class pass when the booking was paid_with_pass=true. Confirmed in server.py lines 5894-5906 — no refund logic at all in the handler. Iteration 21 also flagged this. Two class passes were consumed during UI testing and had to be restored manually via mongosh (27 → 25 → 27). If admin cancels a pass-paid booking in production, the member silently loses the pass. Consider adding: if b.get('paid_with_pass') and not b.get('pass_refunded'): $inc class_pass_credits +1 + pass_ledger entry + $set pass_refunded=true.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py booking_create (lines 1938-1970) per-child dedupe key logic is correct: dupe_q adds child_id when body.child_id is provided; pending same-child re-post returns the existing row (resume); paid/confirmed same-child returns 409 with the child's name in the error message; a different child_id creates a fresh booking. Verified via 5/5 pytest cases + full UI flow.

frontend/app/class/[id].tsx: (1) onBookPress line 226 opens the picker whenever BOTH min_age && max_age are set — no longer gated on childAgeNum being null, so subsequent taps re-open the picker (fixes iteration 20 UX gap). (2) load() lines 114-125 builds bookedChildKeys from myBookings filtered to (class_id === id, status ∈ paid/pending/confirmed/reschedule_requested), keyed by child_id AND a name|age fallback. (3) The picker (line 664) computes alreadyBooked = bookedChildKeys.has(id:<child_id>) || bookedChildKeys.has(na:<name>|<age>), disables the Pressable, applies opacity 0.5 via childRowDisabled, replaces the chevron with a green checkmark, and adds the 'already booked in this class' green label. Verified visually and behaviourally.

frontend/src/api.ts: createBooking correctly forwards child_id as an optional 6th param — the backend receives it and stores it. childRef in [id].tsx (ref-based fix from iteration 21) still cleanly threads child_id/name/age into the createBooking payload at line 137, avoiding the React state-batching stale-closure that iteration 20 uncovered.

Playwright's is_disabled() returned false for the disabled Alice Pressable — this is a known limitation of React Native web (Pressable's `disabled` prop doesn't set the DOM `disabled` attribute). Functionally the row IS non-interactive (verified by the fact that no additional POST /api/bookings fired when the Bob-tap script ran with the picker open). Recommend main agent add aria-disabled or role=button + a stable class marker for future E2E tests, but not blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — picker opens on every tap, disables already-booked child with green checkmark + label, second child bookable, both POST payloads carry child_id/name/age, both admin/bookings rows persist correctly

seed_data_creation: During pytest: created TEST_Alice(10) + TEST_Bob(12) on info@ via /api/me/children; created 2 bookings on cls_a38f3d888984 — the fixture teardown admin-cancelled both and deleted both children. During Playwright UI test: created TEST_UIAlice(10) + TEST_UIBob(12) on info@; created bookings bk_aeb18732aff4 (Alice) + bk_0b9f422a7017 (Bob) both paid_with_pass. After test, both bookings admin-cancelled and both children deleted via /api/me/children/{id}. Because admin cancel does NOT auto-refund passes, class_pass_credits went 27→25; manually restored to 27 via mongosh direct write on maxenergy_db.users to preserve state. Final state verified: info@ children=[], class_pass_credits=27.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified fully working. To regression-run backend only: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_per_child_dedupe.py -p no:xdist -o addopts= -v. To reproduce the UI flow: login info@maxenergy.com.au → seed 2 children via POST /api/me/children (or via /children UI) → /class/cls_a38f3d888984 → tap BOOK & PAY → pick child A → pay-with-pass → back to same class → tap BOOK & PAY again → assert Alice row shows 'already booked in this class' + green checkmark and pick-child-<id> Pressable is disabled visually → pick child B → pay-with-pass → verify /api/admin/bookings has both. Reminder: admin cancel of a pass-paid booking does NOT auto-refund the class pass — restore via direct db update if needed for repeatable runs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in the per-child dedupe feature. Pre-existing pass-refund gap in admin_booking_cancel documented as an action item (not a regression; predates this feature).
